ideas.idea: Use one host everywhere (canonical vs sitemap host disagree)
ideas.why: Restates the known staging canonical problem.

ideas.idea: Remove noindex from services or remove it from the sitemap
ideas.why: Restates the known services noindex/sitemap conflict.

ideas.idea: Back up 'thousands of patients' claim with a real figure, reviews or source
ideas.why: The index.njk claim is unsupported and verifiable evidence helps readers and machines trust it.

ideas.idea: Show actual prices on the services page
ideas.why: services.njk says prices are 'simple and clear' but lists none, so the content is missing.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists with qualifications and years on the team page
ideas.why: team.njk has only a vague 'decades of experience' line with no names or credentials.

ideas.idea: Give each service its own page with its own address
ideas.why: Services are a bare four-item list with no detail, so separate pages would add findable content.

ideas.idea: Complete Dentist JSON-LD with address, opening hours, url and image
ideas.why: The existing block has only name and telephone, while the address is already on the page.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to sitemap entries
ideas.why: Accurate, but it has little effect on a four-page site.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
ideas.why: Accurate, as base.njk has none, but it applies to almost any site and mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Link Team and Services pages to Contact with a booking call to action
ideas.why: Contact is already in the global nav, so the extra links add little.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite or Organization JSON-LD in base.njk for site identity
ideas.why: No site-level identity markup exists, but on a single-location practice it adds little beyond the Dentist block.
